instructions: The best new indie rock, indie pop and indietronica. Submissions: https://www.submithub.com/direct/tonys-playlists
notes: Location evidence is country only: Groover curator profile lists 'Playlist Curator, United States' (https://groover.co/en/influencer/profile/0.tonys-playlists/); no city found. SubmitHub direct route may need credits, so treated as paid. Indie/alt rock focus.

name: Tony's Playlists - Best Alternative Rock
instructions: The best new alt rock, indie rock and psych rock. Submissions: https://www.submithub.com/direct/tonys-playlists
notes: Same curator as Best Indie Rock; US per Groover profile (country only, https://groover.co/en/influencer/profile/0.tonys-playlists/). SubmitHub direct, treated as paid.

name: Before Arcadia - TOP INDIE ROCK
instructions: Indie Rock bands from around the World! For Song submissions: beforearcadia@gmail.com
notes: Curator is the Tampa Bay indie rock band Before Arcadia (https://beforearcadia.com/ describes it as a Tampa Bay indie rock band; its sister playlist 'Tampa Bay Indie Rock' is local-only). This playlist is worldwide indie rock. Band-run, so may favour reciprocal support.

name: Best Indie Alternative - Undiscovered (NeverEnoughMusic.com)
instructions: Playlist description: "(Updated Weekly) - The best undiscovered Indie Alternative Rock Music... https://neverenoughmusiccom.droptrack.com/submit/"
notes: Location evidence is only the Groover profile listing United States (https://groover.co/en/influencer/profile/0.neverenoughmusiccom/); city unknown. DropTrack page is JS-rendered so fees unconfirmed.

name: Jann Klose - Indie Rising
instructions: My alternating favorites and new finds! Email info@3framesmusic.com for submissions.
notes: Curator Jann Klose, New York-based singer-songwriter running label 3 Frames Music; site press releases datelined 'New York City, NY' (https://3framesmusic.com/). Curator first name: Jann. Mixed indie/alt favourites; artist-curator.

name: The Wild Honey Pie: Buzzing
instructions: "Submit an Artist" form: Artist Name, E-mail, Song Link. No fee shown.
notes: Location: "By 2010, The Wild Honey Pie took root in NYC" (https://www.thewildhoneypie.com/about). Playlist description: "Indie and Pop playlist updated weekly. We throw parties and make music videos. No AI music ever." Linked from https://www.thewildhoneypie.com/buzzing-daily. Indie/pop lean rather than rock. hello@thewildhoneypie.com is a general contact, not a submission route.

name: KXSC New Adds
instructions: or Email your submission to submissions@kxsc.org
notes: Location: USC, 3607 Trousdale Parkway, TCC B3, Los Angeles (https://kxsc.org/musicsubmission). Music department's favorite new tracks, updated weekly. Page's mailto link points to music@kxsc.org, inconsistent with submissions@. Page text gives submissions@kxsc.org (used here); the mailto behind it goes to music@kxsc.org.

name: FRESH FINDS (KCSU FM)
instructions: "All other bands/artists: Please submit your music to our music submissions form"; "Inquiries about submissions should be sent to music@kcsufm.com".
notes: Colorado State University student radio; mailing address 1101 Center Ave Mall, Lory Student Center, Fort Collins, CO 80523 (https://kcsufm.com/submitmusic/). Playlist description: "Updated weekly by your very own Music Directors, FRESH FINDS showcases all of their fav newly released music from every genre." The submit page embeds this playlist, but the form is mainly for airplay consideration. All genres.

name: Punk Rock Museum - New Music Friday (PunkRockRadar)
instructions: Playlist description: "Updated Weekly - Submit your release on PunkRockRadar.com or Instagram @PunkRockRadar". Singles form: "UPCOMING PUNK releases only! Submit here to be featured in #NewMusicFriday the week of release!" / "No Reissues, No Live Records, No Acoustic Records. Brand New Music Only" / "If this is not a PUNK ROCK release, it will not be displayed." Albums go via https://punkrockradar.com/album-form/. No fee mentioned.
notes: Location: curator's own Instagram bio (https://www.instagram.com/punkrockradar/, fetched) reads "NY Based - Use the Links to contact / Add Your Upcoming Release (Linktree)"; ~42K IG followers. Punk-only weekly NMF playlist; submit BEFORE the release date. punkrockradar@gmail.com on the site is for podcast/IG-series suggestions, not track submissions, so not used. Run by John Montross per a third-party podcast page (not on his own page, so no first name given).

name: New Indie Pop (Laurelanne / laurelanne.media)
instructions: "Save at least one that matches your sound on Spotify before submitting." "Fill out the submission form with your Spotify track link, the playlist(s) you're targeting, and your contact info. One submission per week." "Accepted tracks are placed in the top 15 positions." "Is playlist placement guaranteed? No." "Tracks should be recent releases or a single you're currently promoting... Tracks released more than six months ago are considered on a case-by-case basis." No fee is stated for the playlist form.
notes: Location evidence: the site footer at https://laurelanne.media/playlist-submission.html says "Editorial coverage and artist marketing services for independent musicians, managers, and music publicists. Based in Atlanta." Laurelanne, LLC is a small PR/marketing outfit that also sells promo packages, but the playlist form itself has no price. The form is follow-gated: you must save one of their playlists first, and they say "We can verify whether playlists were saved". Playlist description: "Indie Pop and Rock. Bedroom pop". It leans pop, so it is only a partial fit for guitar indie. On the site, the 'NOISE CULT' card ("Gritty guitars, raw energy") links to 1U4zesoNxMnbgL2Nnsrs3x, which is now titled 'New Retro Soul & Classic R&B', so NOISE CULT could not be found and is not listed.

name: Chicago Rising: Indie Rock, Alt, and Punk (Matthew Luna)
instructions: Under 100k monthly listeners, music from 2025 onward, sorted by release date (newest first). Discover local indie rock, alt, and punk bands from Chicago. Updated regularly. Submissions: matthew.luna.sounds@gmail.com.
notes: Location evidence: curator's own playlist description at the sourceUrl says it covers 'local indie rock, alt, and punk bands from Chicago' (no separate profile found). Focus is Chicago local scene, so a UK band is a stretch; description only asks for under 100k listeners and 2025+ releases. Curator first name: Matthew.

name: WSUM Adds Roundup
instructions: Music programming contact: music@wsum.wisc.edu. Every week our Music Director chooses new releases to add to our music library.
notes: Location: 333 East Campus Mall, Suite 4100, Madison, WI 53715 (https://wsum.org/contact/). Weekly college radio adds roundup; page does not explicitly invite submissions. Sibling playlists: 0371ZfSaXWTzDk0UqUIQAr, 4IXXOF5R5TpAIyQ3BihYPQ, 2a0e7dnLfFHoPDkCR6LNCJ.

name: A Cold Glow: An Indie Shoegaze Dream Pop Christmas
instructions: Send submissions to @looplinemusic on Instagram or Twitter.
notes: Seasonal (Christmas) shoegaze/dream pop playlist: 'Flurries of sparkling synths, glistening vocals, jingling guitars, and winter vibes.' Location: curator Loop Line's Bandcamp page https://looplinemusic.bandcamp.com shows Minneapolis, Minnesota (curator is a band/project; link between Bandcamp and playlist inferred from matching @looplinemusic handle). No curator first name given.

name: New Core, Nu Punk, Metalcore, Pop Punk, Emo - 2024 (Heat On The Street)
instructions: Playlist description: "submit a song: heatonthestreet.com/playlist-submission". Form page: "The playlist is for DIY and unsigned artists. To submit, Fill in the required fields below and opt into my email list. Make sure you complete the email list confirmation, or I won't get your submission." Email only as a fallback: "If you are already a subscriber to my email list, and are having trouble completing this form, email info@heatonthestreet.com to submit your track." No fee mentioned.
notes: Location: About page https://www.heatonthestreet.com/about/ (fetched): "I'm Todd McCarty. My home base is in Los Angeles, but i'm currently living in Japan for the next couple years." So US home base, but he is currently abroad. Title still says 2024 and the genre is metalcore/pop-punk/post-hardcore, so it may be stale and fits poorly. Curator first name: Todd. Form requires joining a mailing list.

name: New Hardcore, Punk, Ska and Metal (DCxPC Live - Vinyl & More!)
instructions: Playlist description: "A weekly updated list of new hardcore, punk, ska and metal. Submissions welcome. - dcpcbooking@gmail.com."
notes: Location: DCxPC Live's own site https://dcxpclive.com (fetched) lists address "West Hurley, NY, 12491", "United States"; its Bandcamp https://dcxpclive.bandcamp.com also says "West Hurley, New York". Small live-vinyl label. Genre leans hardcore/punk/ska/metal, so an indie/alt-rock band is only a stretch fit unless the track is punky.

name: Hot Girl Pop Punk 2026 (Laurelanne / laurelanne.media)
instructions: Same form as the other Laurelanne playlists: save at least one Laurelanne playlist, then "Fill out the submission form with your Spotify track link, the playlist(s) you're targeting, and your contact info. One submission per week." Tick 'Hot Girl Pop Punk' in the form. No fee is stated.
notes: Location evidence: same as the other Laurelanne row, "Based in Atlanta." (site footer, https://laurelanne.media/playlist-submission.html). Playlist description: "New pop punk for loud girls with bad attitudes. Distorted guitars and scream-it-out energy." It is pitched at female-fronted pop punk, so fit is low unless FloodLines has a pop-punk track. The form is follow-gated.

name: Chicago Rock Bands (Kevin)
instructions: Local Indie, Psych, Garage, Pop: A playlist for people in Chicago to discover local bands, and local bands to discover each other. Submissions email kconroy717@gmail.com. Subject line: CRB Submission - Band/Artist Name - Song Title
notes: Location evidence: curator's own playlist description at the sourceUrl ('for people in Chicago ... local bands'). Explicitly a local Chicago-scene playlist, so non-US band acceptance is unlikely. Curator first name: Kevin.
